lede: The week's sharpest moment is Thursday's special Town Council sitting as an appellate body on a contested HARC approval — a three-story, 34.88-foot addition at 208 S Fir Street that a neighbor has challenged, the kind of hearing that sets precedent for how construction gets reviewed in this town. Before that, Wednesday brings a proposed ordinance to phase out gas-powered lawn equipment townwide, and the TMVOA votes to adopt its 2027 budget and approve a SMART IGA tied to gondola funding. The county commissioners also hold a special session Wednesday to work through 2027 budget adjustments, including wildfire mitigation funding and a Chamber seed-money request.

notable.stake: Council reviews contested HARC approval; outcome sets construction review precedent.
Proposed ordinance would ban gas lawn equipment townwide starting 2028.
TMVOA votes to adopt 2027 budget and approve gondola-linked SMART IGA.
BOCC decides 2027 budget amendments including wildfire mitigation and Chamber funding.
Public hearing on expanded street closure for 2027 Skijoring event.
Housing Authority decides whether to allow $160,000 deed-restricted capital improvement exception.
